name: Ravenous Palm
description: Strike with a palm that ravens at the foe's soul force and pulls a good share into the user.

name: Glutton Sense
description: Sense the fullness of every soul nearby and mark which is richest to feed on.

name: Famished Ward
description: Hold a famished ward that bites at any soul strike pressing on it.

name: Gorging Bolt
description: Loose a bolt of soul that gorges on its target and returns a measure to the user.

name: Insatiable Chain
description: Cast a chain of endless appetite about the foe's soul that tightens as it feeds.

name: Voracious Purge
description: Devour the erosion and the stain from an ally's soul until only clean force remains.

name: Core Marrow Drain
description: Drain the marrow of the foe's soul force in one pull and take it into the user's reserve.

name: Insatiable Hunger
description: Open a field of insatiable hunger that drains every soul standing within it.

name: Consuming Touch
description: Lay a touch on the foe that consumes the soul itself and leaves the body unharmed and empty.

name: Twin Palate
description: Train two palates of the spirit on two souls at once and weigh one against the other.

name: Maw Lash
description: Lash out with a maw of soul force that clamps on the foe and draws a share.

name: Double Maw
description: Hold two maws open before the soul so that whatever slips past the first meets the second.

name: Twin Siphon
description: Draw two siphons from the foe's focus so that his technique falters twice.

name: Dual Gulp
description: Swallow the force drawn by both maws in a single gulp and steady the whole soul.

name: Maw Snare
description: Spring a snare of open maws that clamp on the foe's soul and hold it.

name: Paired Maw
description: Loose twin bolts that gorge on separate parts of the foe's soul at the same moment.

name: Maw Cleansing
description: Let an open maw swallow a curse or a taint that clings to an ally's soul.

name: Gaping Maw
description: Gape a wide maw over a company that swallows a share of every soul beneath it.

name: Maw Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of maws that eats soul strikes and turns the force into strength for the user.

name: Maw Unbound
description: Loose both maws at once on a single soul and take it whole into the user's own.

name: Hawk Gulp
description: Gulp the drawn force like a hawk bolting its prey and feel it settle in the soul.

name: Raptor Taste
description: Taste the air for the faint heat of a soul at a great distance.

name: Stooping Draw
description: Stoop on the foe and draw out a share of his soul force in the same motion.

name: Plume Husk
description: Spread a husk of plumes about the soul that sheds the force of a soul strike.

name: Final Siphon
description: Tap a last siphon into the foe's focus that spoils each technique he tries to raise.

name: Last Talon
description: Sink a talon of soul force through every guard to the core and hook it fast.

name: Feast Purge
description: Take the poison of a soul wound into the user's feast and leave an ally's soul clean.

name: Final Feast
description: Feast on the foe's soul in a single plunge and pour the whole share into the user.

name: Raptor Famine
description: Cast a famine over the ground that strips every soul beneath the raptor's shadow.

name: Plummet Devour
description: Flash from a great height onto a soul and devour a deep share of it before the foe can turn.

name: Gale Hunger Draw
description: Draw a share of the foe's soul force on a rush of the wind.

name: Gale Scenting
description: Taste the wind for the scent of living souls and learn their number.

name: Gale Husk
description: Wrap the soul in a husk of wind and hunger that eats the edge of a strike.

name: Gale Sip
description: Sip the drawn force off the wind and add it to the user's reserve.

name: Gale Creep
description: Creep downwind of the foe's soul-sight so that he cannot find the user.

name: Gale Tether
description: Throw a chain of wind and hunger about the foe's soul that tightens as he pulls.

name: Gale Siphon
description: Draw a siphon off the foe's focus and carry it away on the wind.

name: Gale Fang
description: Drive a fang of wind through the foe's soul shield and bite the core.

name: Gale Purge
description: Blow a stain or a binding out of an ally's soul and eat it on the wind.

name: Gale Feast
description: Gorge on a foe's soul as the wind passes and carry the share back to the user.

name: Gale Famine
description: Send a famine on the wind over a company that strips each soul it crosses.

name: Gale Consumption
description: Take a soul attack whole into the user and return it as a consuming strike.

name: Unspoken Bite
description: Bite into the foe's soul without a word or a sign.

name: Unspoken Taste
description: Taste a soul in silence and learn its vows by their flavor.

name: Unspoken Ward
description: Hold a silent ward that eats the force of a strike without a ripple.

name: Mute Siphon
description: Hold a mute siphon on the foe's focus that robs him of the words of his technique.

name: Hush Spear
description: Thrust a spear of hush through the guard and draw force from the wound.

name: Unspoken Cleanse
description: Eat the stain of a forced oath from an ally's soul without a word.

name: Unspoken Feast
description: Feast without a sound on the foe's soul and keep the whole share for the user.

name: Hushed Famine
description: Spread a hushed famine through a company so that each soul wastes unheard.

name: Devoured Vow
description: Devour the vow that holds a foe's will together until he is left with nothing to stand on.

name: Compass Bite
description: Bite along a fixed line through the foe's soul and draw out what lies on it.

name: Compass Taste
description: Taste the line of a fixed bearing for any soul that crosses it.

name: Compass Husk
description: Hold a husk upon the bearing that eats the force of strikes along it.

name: Compass Draw
description: Draw the foe's focus off its line and into the hunger.

name: Compass Sip
description: Sip the force of the line to refill the user's reserve.

name: Famine Chain
description: Chain the foe's soul to the line of the famine so that he starves where he stands.

name: Famine Bolt
description: Hurl a bolt of famine along the bearing that withers what it strikes.

name: Famine Lance
description: Drive a lance of famine through the guard and drain the core.

name: Famine Purge
description: Take the starving taint out of an ally's soul and eat it.

name: Famine Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of famine that eats soul strikes and feeds the user.

name: Famine Storm
description: Raise a storm of famine along the bearing that strips every soul it meets.

name: Famine Sentence
description: Pass a sentence of famine on one foe that presses down his will and takes his force.

name: Famine Absolute
description: Absorb every soul force that crosses the bearing and return it as a strike that kills by starving.
